description: Search the MoveMentors help center for articles matching a free-text query. Returns the top matches with title, description, category, locale, and a permalink the agent can cite or fetch for the full markdown body. Filter by category slug (e.g., 'payments', 'for-mentors') or locale ('en', 'es', etc.). No auth required.

category.description: Optional category slug. Run with no category once to discover; the response includes categories alongside results.

locale.description: Locale of the article body to search. Defaults to English.

name: search_help_articles
